name: Malayalam chat spellings (hand-written)
verdict_reason: Written by hand for this repository, so there is no third-party licence to follow or credit; the app credits third-party sources only.
attribution: A short table of irregular Manglish chat spellings (nanni for നന്ദി, nte for എന്റെ), written for this keyboard. No third-party data.
used_for: Compiled into the engine: a typed chat spelling offers its Malayalam word (engine/core/src/chat_forms.rs).
